question_verdicts.question: Can DCU4 and system-level delivery convert into confirmed revenue and orders in H2 2026-2027, rather than industry narrative only?

question_verdicts.question: Is the Q1 2026 gross margin decline of 5.59pp product structure, cost, or price competition; where will 2026-2028 gross/net margin settle?

Q1 2026 gross margin is still high at 55.604%, but fell 5.59pp; net margin of 17.0343% fell 4.04pp. Selling expense rose 260.69% and R&D rose 55.05%, indicating reinvestment and competitive intensity. Official H1 ex-share-based payment profit growth supports operating quality, but does not prove gross margin stabilization.

company_disaggregation: Economic unit map: (1) High-end processors, CPU and DCU, is the only reported consolidated segment and is 100% of disclosed revenue. Its revenue equation is volume x ASP x mix, but product-level volume, ASP and mix are not disclosed. Q1 2026 consolidated gross margin is 55.604%, operating margin 24.0529%, net margin 17.0343%. Inventory is CNY 7,518.22 mn and H1 OCF is -427.54 mn. (2) A second analytical unit, server/supernode system integration and delivery, is a possible ecosystem extension but has no separate reported revenue or margin. It should be treated as scenario optionality rather than core valuation. Ranked by revenue weight and valuation sensitivity, the processor unit dominates; system integration is second but unquantified. Customer concentration, channel/geography split and CPU/DCU product split are missing and remain research tasks.
autonomous_forecast_model: Model profile: corporate, volume-price-cost high-R&D technology product manufacturer. Revenue equation: revenue = CPU volume x CPU ASP + DCU volume x DCU ASP + other; because CPU/DCU split is not disclosed, the accepted model is hybrid/top-down at consolidated level. FY2026E revenue = CNY 18,198.17 mn, derived as H1 implied revenue of 9,099.08 mn x 2. H1 implied revenue = 2026H1 R&D investment 2,652.38 mn / 29.15%. FY2026E net margin = 17.0343%, giving parent net profit = 3,099.93 mn and EPS = 1.3337 on 2,324.3381 mn diluted shares. Gross profit, operating profit, finance/other items, income tax and minority interest cannot be fully crossed from the available evidence and remain partial/missing. OCF, capex and FCF for 2026E are missing/not disclosed. 2027E and 2028E revenue, profit, margin, EPS, OCF, capex and FCF are missing/not disclosed. The model must not be labeled bottom-up until segment volume, ASP, margin, utilization and order data are supplied.
thesis_financial_bridge: BR01 revenue bridge: operating driver is volume. Formula: revenue = H1 2026 implied revenue x 2 x scenario adjustment. Base 18,198.17 mn; bull 22,000 mn; bear 16,000 mn. Revenue impact: bull +3,801.83 mn vs base; bear -2,198.17 mn vs base. Profit impact: base 3,099.93 mn; bull 4,070 mn; bear 2,160 mn. EPS impact: base 1.3337; bull 1.7510; bear 0.9293. Other capital impacts unquantified. BR02 margin bridge: base net margin 17.0343%; bull 18.5%; bear 13.5%. Profit and EPS impacts as above; valuation impact depends on margin stability. BR03 cash bridge: OCF = net profit + changes in inventory/receivables/payables; 2026H1 OCF -427.54 mn; full-year OCF/FCF remains unquantified. This caps the base multiple. BR04 valuation bridge: FV/share = forward EPS x scenario PE. Base 1.3337 x 140 = 186.72; bull 1.7510 x 180 = 315.16; bear 0.9293 x 70 = 65.03. The system-integration/supernode unit is not separately valued to avoid double counting.
moat_evidence_verdict: The moat is not proven enough to support the current multiple. X86 compatibility and customer switching costs are logically plausible but lack disclosed ASP, retention, share or repeat-purchase evidence. High R&D intensity is verified at 29.15% of revenue, but gross margin still fell 5.59pp and operating cash flow is negative, so R&D-to-profit conversion is only partial. Domestic security/qualification advantages are asserted but no segment market share or industry win-rate data are available. Therefore the moat should be treated as partial/unproven, not as a basis for paying an aggressive scarcity multiple.
valuation_closure: Core value: 2026E parent net profit of CNY 3,099.93 mn x 140 = CNY 433,990.2 mn equity value, or CNY 186.72/share on 2,324.3381 mn shares. Bull scenario value: CNY 4,070 mn x 180 = CNY 732,600 mn, or CNY 315.16/share. Bear scenario value: CNY 2,160 mn x 70 = CNY 151,200 mn, or CNY 65.03/share. Accepted probabilities: bull 30%, base 50%, bear 20%. Probability-weighted fair value = 0.30 x 315.16 + 0.50 x 186.72 + 0.20 x 65.03 = CNY 200.91/share. System integration/supernode optionality is excluded from core value because no disclosed revenue or margin exists. Current price: CNY 246.33. Expected return = 200.91 / 246.33 - 1 = -18.4%. The negative expected return supports Underweight.
